text:
Anna P: thinking out loud — can we add an "auto-pause" for config rollouts that pauses the rollout when telemetry hits thresholds? e.g. p99_latency > 300ms OR error_rate_5m > 1.5%?
Mike (eng-platform): yes, we've talked about telemetry-gated rollouts before. question: should this live in the console UX or be part of the runtime config API?
Sophia: +1 to having it callable from the API so infra and SRE can trigger/inspect via tools. console can be just a UI wrapper.
Anna P: agreed. convince me on shape: simple schema proposal in one line: `auto_pause: {enabled: true, detect: ["p99_latency_ms:>300:5m","error_rate:>1.5:5m"], action: "pause"}`. thoughts?
Mike (eng-platform): schema parsing in runtime sounds messy. prefer something like `auto_pause: {enabled: true, windows: [{metric: "p99_latency_ms", op: ">", value: "300", duration: "5m"}, ...]}` but i know we tend to avoid nested objects in the current flat runtime config.
Sophia: yeah that's the API debate — current runtime-config proto is flat key/value. Adding structured rules requires migration. Alternative: keep a small DSL string: `p99>300:5m; err5m>1.5%` and runtime parses it. simpler rollout path.
Kai Ops: +1 on DSL string if we can validate it early. SRE needs readable history in audit logs though. DSL is ok as long as console shows parsed readable lines.
Anna P: DSL is tempting for speed. but we need replayability and telem->dashboard mapping. we should standardize metric names: p95_latency_ms, p99_latency_ms, error_rate_5m, throughput_rps. docs need exact names.
Mike (eng-platform): concerning auto actions — do we only "pause" or also rollback/fallback to safe-profile? i prefer pause + notify + optional fallback. pause gives ops time to inspect.
Sophia: can we implement a two-step: when rule tripped -> mark rollout paused (no new cohorts), notify channel, then automatic fallback if paused for >10m and error_rate still >X? keeps things safe.
Anna P: ok that implies runtime needs timers and evaluation loop. costy but reasonable. what's the expected frequency of checks? 30s? 1m?
Kai Ops: 1m is fine. make it configurable: `check_interval_s` default 60.
Mike (eng-platform): UI question: slider for sensitivity? e.g., a "aggressiveness" slider that maps to thresholds presets (conservative/normal/aggressive) instead of typing rules. UX team wants simpler controls for PMs.
Anna P: we can add presets that expand to DSL behind the scenes. console shows the expanded rules so auditors can see exact conditions.
ops-bot: Canary "feature-config-flag-X" started by @Anna P — cohort 1/10.
Sophia: one more internal API nit: should the config change create a rollout resource with status subfields (paused, paused_reason, pause_since, metrics_at_pause)? That helps console and API consumers.
Mike (eng-platform): yes please. that avoids asking runtime for ephemeral state. we already have rollout id flows for model rollouts; reuse pattern.
Anna P: action items: 1) Mike + Sophia sketch API vs DSL options — quick RFC by EOD Friday. 2) Kai — list dashboards and metric name mapping we must support. 3) I'll mock console presets and audit view.
Kai Ops: I'll export current dashboards and confirm metric names by tomorrow.
Mike (eng-platform): syncing with runtime team — if we go DSL, I'll add a small parser lib in runtime-core and a validation step in config service.
Anna P: thanks all — moving this to a short RFC thread. if anyone objects to the DSL path, ping me here. :thumbsup:
